name: InviteDialog
description: A dialog for inviting people, in three shapes: typed emails with a role on one compact line each, a search of a directory you pass, or a two-step pick-from-a-list with a role per person. Checks for format, duplicates and people who are already members, an error summary, an optional message and a submit button that says how many invitations it sends. Your onInvite does the work. UI permission is not security: the server must check again.

variant.description: emails: one compact line per person, typed email and role. search: look people up in a directory you pass and add them to a to-invite list. list: a two-step modal, pick people from a list, then give each a role.

roles.tsType: Array<{ id: string; label: string; description?: string }>
roles.description: The roles a person can be invited as. The description of a role shows in the open list of the role select.

defaultRole.description: The id of the role each new row starts with. Defaults to the first role.

existingEmails.description: Emails that are already members. Typing one is an error on that row. Compared without case.

defaultInvites.description: Rows the emails variant starts with, for example people to invite again. Without it there is one empty row.

people.tsType: Array<{ id: string; name: string; email: string; avatarUrl?: string }>
people.description: The directory for the search and list variants. In search it is what the search looks in unless onSearch is given; in list it is every person that can be picked.

onSearch.tsType: (query: string) => Array<{ id: string; name: string; email: string; avatarUrl?: string }> | Promise<Array<{ id: string; name: string; email: string; avatarUrl?: string }>>
onSearch.description: Search variant only: looks people up on your server as the person types. Return the matches; the latest query wins. Without it, people is filtered in the browser.

maxVisibleRows.description: Rows shown before the list scrolls inside itself, with a fade at the edge that has more. The dialog never grows past 90% of the screen height.

maxInvites.description: The most people one send can hold. Add another is disabled at the limit and says so.

title.description: The dialog's title, shown as its heading. Default: "Invite people"; the list variant shows "Select users" and then "Give user role".

allowMessage.description: Offers an optional message that goes with every invitation, behind an "Add a message" switch. Set false to remove it entirely. The list variant never has one.

messageLabel.description: The label of the message field.

submitLabel.description: The text of the submit button for a number of invitations. Default: "Send invitation" and "Send 3 invitations".

successMessage.description: The status message announced once the dialog has closed after a send. Default: "3 invitations sent".

onInvite.tsType: (invites: Array<{ email: string; role: string; person?: { id: string; name: string; email: string; avatarUrl?: string } }>, details: { message?: string }) => void | import("../form/form").SubmitResult | Promise<void | import("../form/form").SubmitResult>
onInvite.description: Sends the invitations; yours, async. person is set when someone was picked from the directory. Resolve for success. Return { fieldErrors: { "invites[1].email": "..." } } to show a problem on a row, or { formError } for the whole form; a throw also keeps the dialog open.

onCancel.description: Called when the person cancels: the Cancel button or Escape.

onOpenChange.description: Called with false when the dialog closes after a cancel or a successful send. Needed with isOpen.

isOpen.description: Controlled open state, for a dialog opened without a DialogTrigger.

permissions.description: What the app allows: invite. Hidden renders nothing; disabled keeps the dialog but the submit button stays focusable with aria-disabled and the reason shown and read, and nothing is sent. This only changes what people see: the server must check again.

classNames.description: Extra class names for single parts, so you can restyle one part without editing the file. Keys: dialog, form, list, message, toggle, search, results, counter, actions, cancelButton, submitButton, reason, status.

keyboard: Tab: moves through the rows, Add another, the message switch, Cancel and the submit button; focus stays inside the dialog
Enter in an email field: sends
Search variant: Down arrow from the search field moves into the results; Enter adds the person
List variant: Up and Down move between people, Space or Enter picks or drops one, Next goes to the roles step, Prev comes back
requirements: Focus lands on the first email field when the dialog opens, and on a new row's email when one is added
After a send that worked the dialog closes and focus returns to the control that opened it
A failed send keeps the dialog open and moves focus to the error summary; each item moves to its field
Row errors are linked to their field with aria-describedby and aria-invalid
Every row's inputs keep a unique accessible name (Email 2, Role 2) even where the label is visually hidden
Adding and removing a row is announced; a status message tells the result after the dialog closes
The list variant moves focus to the new step's heading on Next and Prev and announces the step politely
A disabled invite stays focusable and the reason is its description
screenReader: "Select users, Choose people, list box, multiple selection"
"3 invitations sent" after the dialog closes

use_when: Inviting people to a team, workspace or account by email, one or many at a time
avoid_when: Adding a user with a full profile: use UserForm
Importing hundreds of people: use a file import flow
anti_patterns: Treating the permissions prop as protection: UI permission is not security, so the server must check again
Sending the invitations from inside the component: onInvite is yours
Closing the dialog yourself after a failed onInvite: it stays open on purpose so the person can fix the rows

contract.data: The roles people can be invited as, the emails of existing members, optionally a directory of people (static or from an async onSearch), and an async onInvite that does the sending.
customization: title, description, messageLabel, submitLabel and successMessage
variant emails, search or list; people and onSearch for a directory
works inside DialogTrigger or controlled with isOpen
